mapper.sql: g.cd_grp_id, g.cd_grp_nm, g.cd_grp_se_cd, g.attr1_nm, g.attr2_nm, g.attr3_nm, g.sort_seq, g.use_yn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cmn.cd_dtl d WHERE d.cd_grp_id = g.cd_grp_id) AS code_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cmn.cd_grp g ORDER BY g.sort_seq, g.cd_grp_id
SELECT cd_grp_id, dtl_cd, cd_nm, attr1_val, attr2_val, attr3_val, sort_seq, use_yn, aply_bgn_dt FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id = #{group} ORDER BY sort_seq, dtl_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.cd_grp (cd_grp_id, cd_grp_nm, cd_grp_se_cd, attr1_nm, attr2_nm, attr3_nm, sort_seq, use_yn, created_by) SELECT #{cd_grp_id}, #{cd_grp_nm}, 'BIZ', #{attr1_nm}, #{attr2_nm}, #{attr3_nm}, COALESCE(MAX(sort_seq), 0) + 1, 'Y', #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT} FROM cmn.cd_grp

INSERT INTO cmn.cd_dtl (cd_grp_id, dtl_cd, cd_nm, attr1_val, attr2_val, attr3_val, sort_seq, use_yn, aply_bgn_dt, created_by) VALUES (#{group}, #{dtl_cd}, #{cd_nm}, #{attr1_val}, #{attr2_val}, #{attr3_val}, #{sort_seq}, 'Y', #{aply_bgn_dt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT})

INSERT INTO cmn.cd_hist (cd_grp_id, dtl_cd, cd_chg_ty_cd, item_nm, bfr_val, aft_val, chg_user_id) VALUES (#{group}, #{code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{type}, #{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{before,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{after,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select:
SELECT h.cd_hist_id, h.cd_grp_id, h.dtl_cd, h.cd_chg_ty_cd, h.item_nm, h.bfr_val, h.aft_val, h.chg_user_id, h.chg_at, CASE WHEN h.cd_grp_id = 'PARAM' THEN '기준값' ELSE g.cd_grp_nm END AS cd_grp_nm FROM cmn.cd_hist h LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id = h.cd_grp_id
ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC, h.cd_hist_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{skip}
